```yaml
name: Approve Workflows for Returning Contributors and Ok-To-Test Label

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [labeled, unlabeled]
    branches: [main, 'release-*']

jobs:
  auto-approve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v2
        with:
          go-version: '1.17'

      - name: Fetch PR information
        id: fetch_pr_info
        run: |
          PR_NUMBER=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          PR_CREATOR=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/$PR_NUMBER | jq -r '.user.login')
          echo "::set-output name=pr_creator::$PR_CREATOR"
          echo "::set-output name=is_first_time_contributor::$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls?state=all&creator=$PR_CREATOR | jq '. | length <= 1' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"

      - name: Check if PR has ok-to-test label
        id: check_label
        run: |
          LABELS=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" https://api.github.com/repos/${{ github.repository }}/issues/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/labels | jq -r '.[].name')
          echo "::set-output name=has_ok_to_test_label::$(echo "$LABELS" | grep -q 'ok-to-test' && echo true || echo false)"

      - name: Approve workflows if not first-time contributor or has ok-to-test label
        if: ${{ steps.check_label.outputs.has_ok_to_test_label == 'true' || steps.fetch_pr_info.outputs.is_first_time_contributor == 'false' }}
        run: |
          echo "Approving workflows..."
          gh workflow run --ref ${{ github.ref }} --workflow workflows.yml --token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
